newsitem.title: UK: France's Perec stars in global Pirelli ad campaign.
newsitem.headline: France's Perec stars in global Pirelli ad campaign.

text.p: One of the fastest women in the world, Marie-Jose Perec from France, stars in a new, global advertising campaign launched by Pirelli, the Italian tyre-maker said on Friday.

Perec, who was born in Guadeloupe and won the 200- and 400-metre women's events at the Atlanta Olympics last year, is shown running and escaping from avalanches, tidal waves, burning lava and various monsters in the new television commercials.
The commercials, created by Young & Rubicam, London, will be broadcast in Europe, the United States, Latin America and Asia, including Japan and China, beginning March 8.
Pirelli gave no details on the amount of money being spent on the ad campaign, which was directed by Gerard de Thame and will last through 1998.
The commercials were shot in Vail, Colorado, Zion Park, Utah, the Mojave Desert, Buffalo Bill Lake, Wyoming, Anchorage, Alaska and other locations.
Perec is the third internationally-known figure used by Pirelli to promote its tyres. The screen star Sharon Stone and Olympic medal-winner Carl Lewis starred in earlier ad campaigns by Pirelli.
Perec was voted French sports personality for the second time in December 1996. The first time was in 1992 after she won the 400 metre race at the Barcelona Colympics.

Pirelli, which makes car and truck tyres, has about a 10-percent share of the Europe truck tyre market with one million truck tyres sold each year. It supplies to all the principle truck makers, including Mercedes, Iveco, MAN, Volvo and Scania.
Pirelli said a print advertising campaign had been created to accompany the new TV commercials.
